newsitem.title: USA: Tenneco backs Q3 consensus EPS estimate.
newsitem.headline: Tenneco backs Q3 consensus EPS estimate.

text.p: Tenneco Inc chief executive Dana Mead said the company is comfortable with the First Call consensus of nine analysts' third-quarter earnings estimates of $0.70 per share, compared to $0.90 per share a year ago.
"We're not arguing with that," Mead said following remarks made on Monday to the Council of Institutional Investors.
He declined to comment on estimated results for the fiscal year, citing continued federal government review of several Tenneco restructuring proposals.
The third-quarter year-ago figure includes earnings from spun-off Case Corp, the company said. Earnings excluding Case were $0.53 per share in the year-ago period.
